1: // Simple Neon Runner game
2: (() => {
3:   // Audio setup
4:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
5:   // Ensure context is resumed on first interaction
6:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
7:   canvas.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, { once: true });
8:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', resumeAudio, { once: true });
9: 
10:   const playSound = (freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.1) => {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.type = type;
14:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     osc.start();
18:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:   };
20:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
21:   if (!canvas) return;
22:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
23:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
24:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
25: 
26:   const GRAVITY = 0.6, JUMP = -12, SPEED = 4;
27:   let score = 0, lives = 3, running = true;
28: 
29:   const player = { x: 80, y: canvas.height - 30, r: 12, vy: 0, onGround: true };
30:   const obstacles = [], shards = [];
31:   let frame = 0;
32: 
33:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
34:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
35:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: canvas.height - h, w: 20, h });
36:   };
37:   const spawnShard = () => {
38:     const size = 8;
39:     const y = canvas.height - 30 - Math.random() * 120;
40:     shards.push({ x: canvas.width, y, size });
41:   };
42: 
43:   const rectCollision = (p, o) => {
44:     const distX = Math.abs(p.x - o.x - o.w / 2);
45:     const distY = Math.abs(p.y - o.y - o.h / 2);
46:     return distX <= o.w / 2 + p.r && distY <= o.h / 2 + p.r;
47:   };
48:   const circleCollision = (p, s) => {
49:     const dx = p.x - s.x; const dy = p.y - s.y;
50:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < (p.r + s.size) ** 2;
51:   };
52: 
53:   const update = () => {
54:     // player physics
55:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
56:     player.y += player.vy;
57:     if (player.y >= canvas.height - player.r) {
58:       player.y = canvas.height - player.r;
59:       player.vy = 0;
60:       player.onGround = true;
61:     }
62:     // obstacles movement
63:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
64:     shards.forEach(s => s.x -= SPEED);
65:     // spawn logic
66:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
67:     if (frame % 180 === 0) spawnShard();
68:     // collision detection
69:     obstacles.forEach((o, i) => {
70:       if (rectCollision(player, o)) {
71:           playSound(120, 'sawtooth', 0.2); // collision sound
72:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
73:         lives--;
74:         if (lives <= 0) running = false;
75:       }
76:     });
77:     shards.forEach((s, i) => {
78: if (circleCollision(player, s)) {
79:           shards.splice(i, 1);
80:           score += 10;
81:           playSound(600, 'triangle', 0.05); // shard collect sound
82:         }
83:     });
84:     // cleanup offscreen
85:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
86:     while (shards.length && shards[0].x + shards[0].size < 0) shards.shift();
87:     frame++;
88:   };
89: 
90:   const draw = () => {
91:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
92:     // background gradient and grid lines
93:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
94:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2a');
95:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
96:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
97:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
98:     // subtle vertical neon grid
99:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.05)';
100:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
101:     for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 40) {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
104:       ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
105:       ctx.stroke();
106:     }
107:     for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 40) {
108:       ctx.beginPath();
109:       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
110:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
111:       ctx.stroke();
112:     }
113:     // player with neon glow
114:     ctx.save();
115:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
116:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
117:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, player.r * 0.2, player.x, player.y, player.r);
118:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
119:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
120:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
121:     ctx.beginPath();
122:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
123:     ctx.fill();
124:     ctx.restore();
125:     // obstacles with neon glow
126:     ctx.save();
127:     ctx.shadowColor = '#f00';
128:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
129:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
130:       // draw with gradient for depth
131:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
132:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4d4d');
133:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#990000');
134:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
135:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
136:     });
137:     ctx.restore();
138:     // shards with neon glow
139:     ctx.save();
140:     ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0';
141:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
142:     shards.forEach(s => {
143:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, s.size * 0.2, s.x, s.y, s.size);
144:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
145:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#660');
146:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
147:       ctx.beginPath();
148:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
149:       ctx.fill();
150:     });
151:     ctx.restore();
152:     // UI
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
154:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
155:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
156:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, 10, 40);
157:   };
158: 
159:   const loop = () => {
160:     if (!running) { ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 40, canvas.height / 2); return; }
161:     update();
162:     draw();
163:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164:   };
165: 
166:   // input
167:   const onJump = (e) => {
168:     if (player.onGround) {
169:       player.vy = JUMP;
170:       player.onGround = false;
171:       playSound(300, 'square', 0.08); // jump sound
172:     }
173:   };
174:   canvas.addEventListener('click', onJump);
175:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onJump);
176: 
177:   loop();
178: })();

(End of file - total 178 lines)
